options.reason: The table is a gene-expression matrix of 981 TCGA tumours with a five-level PAM50 subtype label, so the evident task is multiclass classification of PAM50 from expression; select on TCGA and evaluate once on the CPTAC external cohort, reporting macro-F1, per-class precision-recall and a confusion matrix. sample_id is a row key and must not be a feature.
options.title: multiclass
